reply_text:
I’d fix these before merging. Reviewed `excerpt-helper` at `59856d7` against `main`.

1. **[P1] The helpers aren’t connected to cards.** `src/card.js:2` still returns `entry.body.trim()`; nothing calls `toPlain` or `excerpt`. A long markdown body therefore renders unchanged, so this branch doesn’t yet deliver the card previews.

2. **[P1] Short text gets truncated and always receives an ellipsis.** `src/excerpt.js:6–8` never checks whether the text already fits.
   - `excerpt('hello world', 20)` → `'hello…'`
   - `excerpt('hello', 20)` → `'hello…'`
   - `excerpt('', 20)` → `'…'`
   
   This contradicts the documented unchanged-text and ellipsis rules. Return fitting text before finding a cut point.

3. **[P2] A word ending exactly at the limit is unnecessarily dropped.** `src/words.js:2–3` excludes the character at index `limit` when searching for a space. `excerpt('one two three', 7)` returns `'one…'`, although `'one two…'` fits the documented boundary. The current words test actually locks in this incorrect behavior.

4. **[P2] Markdown stripping deletes literal content.** `src/plain.js:3` removes every underscore, tilde, asterisk, and backtick regardless of whether it is markup. For example, `toPlain('snake_case and foo_bar')` returns `'snakecase and foobar'`. Ordinary identifiers and inline-code content are silently corrupted; stripping needs to distinguish formatting delimiters from literal characters.

**Validation:** All four existing tests pass; additional direct checks reproduced the issues above. No files changed.
